definition_zh: 毛细血管；毛细管；毛细现象的；细如毛发的
definition_en: the thinnest blood vessel, or a very narrow tube through which liquid rises by surface forces
core_image: 一根细到只容一个红血球通过的管子，液体却沿着它自动上升
scene: 显微镜下，红细胞排成一列缓缓前行。A red blood cell squeezes through a capillary only one cell wide.
sceneCN: 这里 capillary 指「毛细血管」（第 1 个义项：直径极小、只容一个血细胞通过的血管）；句意：一个红细胞挤过一根只有它一个细胞宽的毛细血管。图中可辨识物件：毛细血管剖面、红细胞、内皮细胞、血流方向箭头。

pos.zh: 毛细的；毛细作用的；细如毛发的

senses.title: Smallest blood vessel
senses.titleCN: 毛细血管：最细的血管，物质交换在此进行
senses.definition: the smallest blood vessel, thin enough for oxygen and nutrients to pass between blood and tissue
senses.definitionCN: 最细的血管，其管壁薄到足以让氧与养分在血液与组织之间通过
senses.example: A red blood cell squeezes through a capillary only one cell wide.
senses.exampleCN: 一个红细胞挤过一根只有它一个细胞宽的毛细血管。
senses.why: Hair and a blood vessel look alike in one respect only: both are extremely thin, so Latin capillaris 'of hair' was borrowed for the finest vessels.
senses.whyCN: 头发与血管只有一点相似：都极细，因此拉丁 capillaris「毛发的」被借来指最细的血管。

senses.title: Capillary bed
senses.titleCN: 毛细血管床：一片交织成网的微血管
senses.definition: a dense network of capillaries in an organ, where gas, nutrients and waste are exchanged
senses.definitionCN: 器官内密集交织的毛细血管网，气体、养分与废物在此交换
senses.example: The capillary bed of the lung covers a huge surface in a small space.
senses.exampleCN: 肺的毛细血管床在很小的空间里铺开巨大的表面。
senses.why: One capillary exchanges almost nothing; a whole woven bed is what an organ needs, so the singular word is used collectively for the network.
senses.whyCN: 单根毛细血管几乎完不成交换；器官需要的是一整片交织的床，于是这个单数名词被集合地用来指整张网。

senses.title: Narrow lab tube
senses.titleCN: 毛细管：实验室与仪器中的细玻璃管
senses.definition: a very narrow tube used in laboratories, thermometers and instruments to hold or move small amounts of liquid
senses.definitionCN: 实验室、温度计与仪器中盛放或移动少量液体的极细管子
senses.example: A few drops of serum were drawn up into a glass capillary.
senses.exampleCN: 几滴血清被吸进一根玻璃毛细管。
senses.why: Glass tubing narrow enough to be called hair-like behaves differently from ordinary tubing, so the adjective became a name for the object itself.
senses.whyCN: 细到可称「如发」的玻璃管表现得与普通管不同，于是这个形容词变成了这种物件本身的名称。

senses.title: Capillary action
senses.titleCN: 毛细作用：液体在细窄空隙中自行上升
senses.definition: the rise or movement of a liquid in narrow spaces caused by adhesion and surface tension, without pressure from outside
senses.definitionCN: 液体在细窄空间中因附着与表面张力而自行上升或移动，无需外部压力
senses.example: Capillary action pulls water up through the soil toward dry roots.
senses.exampleCN: 毛细作用把水通过土壤向上拉到干燥的根部。
senses.why: In a narrow tube the liquid clings to the walls and the surface curves, and that curve pulls liquid upward; the effect is named after the tube that shows it.
senses.whyCN: 在细管中液体贴附管壁、液面弯曲，而弯曲的液面又把液体往上拉；这一效应以展示它的管子命名。

senses.title: Capillary water in soil
senses.titleCN: 土壤毛细水：保存在细小孔隙中的水
senses.definition: water held in the small pores of soil and able to move upward through them toward plant roots
senses.definitionCN: 保存在土壤细小孔隙中、能沿孔隙向上移动到植物根部的水
senses.example: Capillary water keeps the topsoil moist for weeks after rain.
senses.exampleCN: 雨后毛细水能让表土保持湿润数周。
senses.why: Soil is a mass of tiny tubes, so the same physics that lifts water in glass lifts it in earth, and agronomy borrowed the word.
senses.whyCN: 土壤就是无数细管的集合，抬升玻璃管中水的同一套物理也抬升土中的水，农学便借用了这个词。

senses.title: Capillary wave
senses.titleCN: 毛细波：表面张力主导的细小波纹
senses.definition: a tiny ripple on a liquid surface whose restoring force is surface tension rather than gravity
senses.definitionCN: 液面上由表面张力而非重力主导的细微波纹
senses.example: Wind first raises capillary waves, which grow into larger ripples.
senses.exampleCN: 风先掀起毛细波，再长成更大的涟漪。
senses.why: The smallest waves are ruled by the same surface force as narrow tubes, so oceanography applied the word to a wavelength regime rather than to a vessel.
senses.whyCN: 最小的波与细管受同一种表面力支配，于是海洋学把这个词用到一个波长区段，而不是一件器物。

senses.title: Capillary permeability
senses.titleCN: 毛细血管通透性：管壁漏出液体与细胞的能力
senses.definition: the property of capillary walls that allows fluid, proteins or cells to leak into surrounding tissue
senses.definitionCN: 毛细血管壁让液体、蛋白质或细胞漏入周围组织的性质
senses.example: Inflammation increases capillary permeability and causes swelling.
senses.exampleCN: 炎症会提高毛细血管通透性，引起肿胀。
senses.why: Because the wall is only one cell thick, its leakiness is a variable that disease can raise or drugs can lower, so it needed a name.
senses.whyCN: 由于管壁只有一层细胞厚，它的渗漏程度是疾病可升高、药物可降低的变量，因此需要一个名称。

senses.title: Hair-like, slender
senses.titleCN: 细如毛发的：本义中的「毛发状」
senses.definition: literally 'hair-like', a rare descriptive use of the adjective in older technical writing
senses.definitionCN: 字面「如毛发般的」，是较早技术文献中罕见的描述用法
senses.example: The old text speaks of a capillary fracture, meaning a hair-thin crack.
senses.exampleCN: 旧文献提到 capillary fracture，指的是细如发丝的裂缝。
senses.why: This is the literal Latin sense before anatomy took the word over: capillus is a hair, and anything thread-thin could be called capillary.
senses.whyCN: 这是解剖学占用这个词之前的拉丁本义：capillus 是头发，任何细如线的东西都可以叫 capillary。

intro.en: Capillary is Latin capillaris 'of hair', from capillus 'hair'. It entered English as a description of hair-thin structures and was then fixed to the finest blood vessels.
intro.cn: capillary 是拉丁 capillaris「毛发的」，来自 capillus「头发」。它先以「细如毛发之物」进入英语，随后被固定到最细的血管上。

items.en: Capillus meant the hair of the head. It is usually explained as a compound of caput 'head' and pilus 'hair', but that formation is a reconstruction and not a recorded derivation.
items.cn: capillus 指头上的毛发。通常把它解释为 caput「头」与 pilus「毛发」的复合，但这一构成属重构，并非有记录的派生过程。

items.en: The adjective capillaris meant 'of hair, hair-like' and could describe anything as fine as a thread, from roots to cracks in stone.
items.cn: 形容词 capillaris 意为「毛发的、如毛发的」，可形容任何细如线的东西，从根须到石上的裂缝。

items.en: After the fine vessels were seen under the microscope in the seventeenth century, capillary was applied to them because their bore is about the width of a hair.
items.cn: 17 世纪人们在显微镜下看到这些细血管后，capillary 被用于它们，因为其管径约只有一根头发那么宽。

items.en: Studies of liquids in narrow tubes gave the noun and adjective a second life in physics: capillary action, capillary tube, and later capillarity as the name of the effect.
items.cn: 对细管中液体的研究让这个词在物理学中获得第二次生命：毛细作用、毛细管，后来还有 capillarity 这一效应名称。

items.en: Twentieth-century science extended it to soil water, surface ripples and wall leakiness, while medicine kept the anatomical sense as the dominant one.
items.cn: 20 世纪的科学把它延伸到土壤水、表面波纹与管壁渗漏，医学则让解剖义保持主导。

items.en: Source uncertainty: the caput plus pilus explanation of capillus is not proven, and the precise first English date of capillary is not firmly fixed, though it is seventeenth-century.
items.cn: 来源不确定（词根构成存疑，仅首见年代存疑）：capillus 等于 caput 加 pilus 的解释未获确证；capillary 的英语确切首见年代无定论，但可定在 17 世纪。

note.en: The first group holds look-alikes that share the hair idea or a similar shape; the second holds vessels and narrow-tube words that neighbour capillary in meaning.
note.cn: 第一组是共享「毛发」意象或形状相近的词；第二组是在语义上与 capillary 相邻的血管名与细管词。

entries.definition: The Latin noun for hair, cited in etymology but not used as an English word.
entries.definitionCN: 拉丁语中表「头发」的名词，只出现在词源说明里，不作英语词使用。

entries.definition: The name of the effect by which liquid rises in narrow spaces; capillary is the tube or vessel that shows it.
entries.definitionCN: 指液体在细窄空间上升这一效应的名称；capillary 是显示该效应的管子或血管。

entries.definition: A rare adjective meaning 'hair-like', used in botany for fine hairs; it keeps the literal Latin sense.
entries.definitionCN: 罕用形容词，意为「如毛的」，植物学中用于细毛，保留拉丁本义。

entries.definition: From Latin caput 'head' but through capitalis 'of the head'; the shared element is caput, not capillus.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁 caput「头」，但经由 capitalis「头的」；共享成分是 caput，而非 capillus。

entries.definition: The smallest artery, feeding a capillary bed; it is on the arterial side of the exchange.
entries.definitionCN: 最小的动脉，为毛细血管床供血，位于交换的动脉一侧。

entries.definition: The smallest vein, collecting blood from capillaries; the mirror of the arteriole.
entries.definitionCN: 最小的静脉，从毛细血管收集血液，与微动脉相对。

entries.definition: A wider, leakier exchange vessel found in the liver and spleen, not a true capillary but doing similar work.
entries.definitionCN: 肝与脾中更宽、更易渗漏的交换血管，并非真正的毛细血管，但承担类似功能。

entries.definition: Any very small vessel, including capillaries, arterioles and venules as one group.
entries.definitionCN: 任何极小的血管，把毛细血管、微动脉与微静脉作为一个整体。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: capillus 'hair' + -aris 'relating to' gives 'hair-like', the literal picture of the finest vessel.
normal.cn: capillus「头发」+ -aris「与…有关」得出「如毛的」，正是最细血管的字面画面。

normal.en: The family runs capillary, capillaries, capillarity, capillaceous and the clinical compound capillaroscopy.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 capillary、capillaries、capillarity、capillaceous 以及临床复合词 capillaroscopy。

normal.en: Fixed phrases split into anatomy and physics: capillary bed versus capillary action.
normal.cn: 固定搭配分成解剖与物理两路：毛细血管床 对 毛细作用。

normal.en: capillary is a noun and an adjective; only the noun has the plural capillaries.
normal.cn: capillary 既是名词又是形容词；只有名词才有复数 capillaries。

normal.en: The exchange trio runs arteriole, capillary, venule in that order.
normal.cn: 交换三联按顺序是微动脉、毛细血管、微静脉。

abstract.en: Picture a tunnel so narrow that a single red cell has to flatten itself to pass.
abstract.cn: 想象一条窄到红细胞必须压扁身体才能通过的隧道。

abstract.en: Picture water climbing a glass tube without any pump, only the pull of the walls.
abstract.cn: 想象水在没有泵的情况下沿玻璃管上爬，只靠管壁的拉力。

abstract.en: Picture a leaf's fine hairs and a body's fine vessels as two drawings of the same line.
abstract.cn: 想象叶上的细毛与体内的细血管，是同一根线的两幅画。

examples.en: Oxygen diffuses across the capillary wall into the muscle.
examples.cn: 氧穿过毛细血管壁扩散进肌肉。

examples.en: In dry soil, capillary action can move water upward from below.
examples.cn: 在干燥土壤中，毛细作用能把水从下方往上移动。

examples.en: The laboratory used a capillary tube to collect the sample.
examples.cn: 实验室用一根毛细管收集样本。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「capill 毛发 + ary 的」——细得像头发丝的管子 → capillary 毛细血管／毛细管

root: 拉丁 capillus「头发」→ 拉丁 capillaris「毛发的；如毛的」→ 英语 capillary，17 世纪起固定指最细的血管。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one hair-thin bore: the finest vessel, the bed it forms, the lab tube with the same bore, the force that lifts liquid inside it, soil water, tiny surface waves, the leakiness of its wall, and the literal 'hair-like' sense.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一条如发丝般的管径展开：最细的血管、它构成的血管床、同样细的实验室管、在管内抬升液体的力、土壤水、表面细波、管壁的渗漏，以及字面的「如毛发」义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tube no wider than a hair, one red cell passing through it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根不比头发宽的管子，一个红细胞正从中通过。

branches.en: BODY: one vessel and the network it forms inside an organ.
branches.cn: 身体：一根血管与它在器官内构成的网。

branches.en: GLASS AND FORCE: the same bore in the laboratory, and the surface force that lifts liquid in it.
branches.cn: 玻璃与力：实验室中同样的管径，以及在管内抬升液体的表面力。

branches.en: EARTH: soil pores act as countless small tubes for water.
branches.cn: 大地：土壤孔隙充当无数根输水的小管。

branches.en: WATER SURFACE: the smallest ripples are ruled by the same surface force.
branches.cn: 水面：最小的波纹受同一种表面力支配。

branches.en: THE WALL AND THE WORD ITSELF: leakiness is a property of the wall, and 'hair-like' is the literal sense underneath everything.
branches.cn: 管壁与词本身：渗漏是管壁的属性，而「如毛发」是底下那层字面义。

intro.en: Capillary is capill- 'hair' plus -ary 'relating to'; the same stem with -ity gives capillarity, the name of the physical effect.
intro.cn: capillary 是 capill-「毛发」加 -ary「与…有关的」；同一词干加 -ity 得到 capillarity，即该物理效应的名称。

latinIntro.en: Latin capillus and its adjective capillaris supply the family; the Greek-derived prefix peri- extends it to 'around the capillary' in clinical use.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 capillus 及其形容词 capillaris 提供整个词族；希腊来源的前缀 peri- 在临床用语中把它扩展到「毛细血管周围」。

items.example: The capillary carries one cell at a time.
items.exampleCN: 这根毛细血管一次只通过一个细胞。

items.example: The drug widens the capillaries near the skin.
items.exampleCN: 这种药使皮肤附近的毛细血管扩张。

items.meaning: the rise of liquid in narrow spaces
items.meaningCN: 液体在细窄空间上升的性质
items.exampleCN: 毛细作用使灯芯保持湿润。
茎上覆盖着如毛的细毛。

items.example: Capillaritis leaves brown marks on the skin.
items.exampleCN: 毛细血管炎会在皮肤上留下褐色斑。

items.meaningCN: 毛细血管的显微镜检查
items.exampleCN: 甲襞毛细血管镜检可显示甲襞血管。

items.example: Fluid gathered in the pericapillary space.
items.exampleCN: 液体聚集在毛细血管周围间隙。

items.example: Capillary leak causes a sudden drop in blood pressure.
items.exampleCN: 毛细血管渗漏会造成血压骤降。

latinEntries.meaning: a head of hair; a filament
